captureContract.captureMode: GDI BitBlt against the live Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 SDL window discovered via EnumWindows filtered to the spawned subprocess.pid
configRewriteOnSandbox: fullscreen=0 (avoid stealing the desktop during capture)
show_endoom=0 (skip the ENDOOM text screen on quit)
captureContract.liveCaptureGate: test/plan_final/oracle/capture-reference-title-frame.test.ts gates the live capture behind a check for every REFERENCE_SANDBOX_POLICY.requiredFiles entry being present on disk; the live test then asserts the runner returns either a fully-shaped ReferenceTitleFrameEvidence record (window opened path) or throws ReferenceWindowNotFoundError after the configured timeout (window-never-opened path on hosts where the SDL 1.2 video init does not register a window in Win32). Both contract branches pass uniformly.
